## Meaning

This monitor fired because the signal deviated from its learned SEASONAL baseline — same hour, same day of week. Normal daily and weekly cycles are already accounted for.

Query:

```
avg(last_4h):anomalies(avg:acme.batch.duration_seconds{__SCOPE__} by {service,job_name}, 'robust', 3, direction='above', seasonality='daily') >= 1
```

**Design note.** The earliest reliable warning that tonight's batch will miss its window — hours before the missed-completion monitor would fire.

## Impact

Nothing is broken yet. A boundary will be crossed if nobody acts within the lead time this monitor provides.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-batch-completion`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-batch-job` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `job_run_history`, `job_log_tail`, `upstream_dependency_state`.

Attached to the alert automatically: last 10 runs with durations, log tail, upstream readiness.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `application-development` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `sre`.
3. Priority contract: P3 — next business day; this never pages.
